judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own message types (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` field) instead of the ticket-specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (with `conversations` field), and uses wrong TypeScript interface names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`). It directly violates the explicit ticket requirement to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error when a store lacks `listFor`, returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead, and completely omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`. Furthermore, the validator accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` when the ticket requires `1-200`, and logs the raw store error message on failure (a security/privacy leak explicitly prohibited by the ticket). Finally, it misses the required updates to `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `StoreCannotList`.
